_description: Employment savings routed to Roth account via accountId. Verifies that contributions grow the designated account, not the default.
_rationale: Start with 0 in Traditional and 0 in Roth. Employment savings of 50k/yr (after_tax) for 5 years (age 60-64), routed to roth-1. 0% return. No spending. After 5 years, roth should have ~250k (50k/yr * 5) and traditional should remain 0. No taxes on after_tax income.
name: Employment Savings Routing
